access: Compatible APEX workspace for Customers; authorized licensed test tenant for Fusion/EBS.
finding: The official APEX repository supplies versioned installable apps. Customers is now forked on branch 26.2. Oracle Forms may run outside the browser; the exact surface must be qualified.
limit: APEX is not Fusion ERP or EBS. No workspace import or live Oracle URL is verified.
scenario: Create a synthetic customer, add a contact, log activity and verify the filtered report.

route: Fiori/CAP sample now; licensed ERP environment next
access: Host the existing CAP sample; obtain an approved S/4HANA/ECC test/demo environment for ERP workflows.
finding: The public-edition basic trial is a shared, limited exploration environment. SAP states that partners cannot use that trial for testing, demo and development. The advanced S/4HANA trial has infrastructure/hosting charges.
limit: Do not use the basic trial as the commercial testing lab. UI5/CAP is not an S/4HANA backend or Windows SAP GUI.
scenario: First: event registration and admin confirmation in CAP. Later: a selected synthetic purchase request in an approved ERP test tenant.

route: Personal development tenant beta or existing test tenant
access: Workday currently advertises open developer registration and requests for personal development tenants in beta. Verify allocation and demo rights before relying on it.
finding: A newer public developer route exists; older company-admin-only documentation does not capture every current option. Development-tenant access is not proof that all native HCM/payroll modules or role flows are available.
limit: No account or tenant was created. Do not use employee records or imply full Workday product coverage from an Extend exercise.
scenario: Proposed Extend app: submit a synthetic service request, review it as an authorized approver and verify its status.
needs: Existing tenant or personal-beta account route

route: Approved demo/test instance; PDI for permitted personal learning
access: ServiceNow offers Personal Developer Instances for learning, exploration and experimentation, with availability, hibernation and reclamation limits.
finding: The PDI guide expressly excludes business/production use. For this commercial growth experiment, qualify a licensed/partner demo instance and its permitted audience instead of assuming a free PDI can be a shared marketing sandbox.
limit: No instance is allocated. A GitHub app export requires a ServiceNow runtime; it is not a self-hosted web app. No general permissive license was found on the inspected training export, so it was not rebranded or republished.
scenario: Proposed synthetic service request: submit, route to a test queue, update status and confirm the requester view.
needs: Session expiry, reset and no outbound notifications

route: Practice environment for qualification; approved tenant for demos
access: Pega Academy describes a 30-day Community Edition practice environment. Confirm current allocation, allowed usage and expiry; use an approved licensed environment for a shared commercial demonstration.
finding: The official React SDK is public, but it needs a compatible Pega server and Constellation-enabled application. Its code license does not supply the Pega backend. Select an exact released SDK/server pair rather than unpinned main.
limit: No Community Edition account, licensed tenant or connected SDK run is verified. The public SDK is not a complete Pega clone.
scenario: Proposed case workflow: create a synthetic request, route for approval, request missing information and complete the case.
needs: Community Edition or existing nonproduction tenant
Exact Pega version and UI architecture
Approved case type and test roles
Commercial recording/demo permission and expiry plan

limit: No Infor tenant or runtime is verified. No product-wide compatibility claim is made.

Dedicated test user and synthetic records
